function: Channel prediction: an RNN predicts BS-RIS and RIS-UE channel coefficients (magnitude and phase) of the remaining RIS elements from estimates at a few transmitting elements (pp. 3, 7).
system: BS (Nt antennas) and UE (Nr) with analog beamforming; 8x8 RIS with mode-switching elements (reflection or transmission); single-antenna controller receiver; mmWave band, frequency not given (pp. 4-5, 8).
method: RNN (SimpleRNN plus two dense layers) with magnitude and phase preprocessing and space-stamps; pre-trained offline with SGD, lr 0.001, 100 epochs, batch 32; supervised regression implied (pp. 7-8).
data_channel: Simulated Rician fading channels, kappa = 8 dB, spatial correlation sinc(2d/lambda) between RIS elements; no standard 3GPP model, public dataset or measurement named (pp. 6, 8).
test_conditions: Training set size and split not stated; results on simulated Rician channels sweeping transmit-element number and positions, element spacing, RIS size and estimator error (pp. 8-13).
baselines: Non-learned: linear interpolator (LI), and perfect-CSI benchmark for BER; learned: CNN predictor; compared on channel-phase AMSE (pp. 12-13).
metrics: AMSE of channel magnitude and phase; CSI acquisition latency (analytic); BER versus RIS size (pp. 8, 12-13).
complexity: Orders given: algorithm O(N^2 + N_f(L+L_u+1)), RNN training O(N_e N_s N L_H^2), inference O(N R_h), memory O(max(N^2, N R_h + R_h^2)) (pp. 7-8).
q1_support: p. 8: "All the Rician channel coefficients are generated with κ = 8 dB." Custom Rician simulator with sinc correlation (p. 6). Missing: no 3GPP TR 38.901, DeepMIMO, COST 2100 or measured data.
q2_support: p. 8: "We first consider a SORIS with 8 × 8 elements." Missing: no statement that a trained RNN is tested on an unseen scenario; the RNN input layer has N units (p. 7), and Fig. 11 only sweeps the estimator error.
q3_support: p. 12: "RNN outperforms both CNN and LI" on the channel-phase AMSE (Fig. 10); LI is linear interpolation (non-learned) and CNN is a standard learned architecture on the same problem.
q4_support: p. 8: "lower complexity of O(N × Rh ) per execution"; the overall order O(N^2 + N_f(L+L_u+1)) and the training order are also given in Section III-C (pp. 7-8).
q5_support: p. 8: "All the Rician channel coefficients are generated with κ = 8 dB." Simulated channels. Missing: no code or data link, DOI or public dataset anywhere in the paper.
notes: Included, area 2: the learned element is the RNN channel predictor (the paper also proposes SORIS hardware, a metasurface hardware design, which by itself would not pass the function check). RIS elements switch between reflection and transmission (p. 4). q3 rests on Fig. 10 (p. 12). Training data size, train/test split and carrier frequency are not stated.
